visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a dark beard, wearing a blue baseball cap and a light green short-sleeved school uniform shirt, stands in a tiered seating area. He has a grey patterned tie draped loosely around his neck and gestures with his hands while speaking. The background consists of light wood-colored wooden steps with bright red, yellow, and blue circular cushions. The indoor lighting is bright and even. (2) A series of rapid visual cuts occur. First, a black Mercedes G-Wagon is parked on a wet asphalt road surrounded by green trees in a misty, rainy environment. Next, a close-up shot shows a hand interacting with a stock market application on an iPhone resting on a green table. Then, two people's hands are shown at a white desk; one person signs a document while the other points. Finally, a low-angle shot captures a wet city street at night with crosswalk markings and distant city lights. (3) The scene returns to the man in the light green shirt. He is now in a different indoor setting, pointing enthusiastically towards a large television screen displaying the 'Straight A' logo and text. He holds a silver MacBook laptop, displaying the screen towards the camera. The background shows a spacious, modern hall with a grand piano and large windows. (4) The focus shifts to a retail display area featuring various Apple products. Close-up shots showcase several iPads with keyboard attachments, MacBooks in their retail packaging, and a gold iPhone 15 Pro box. The man appears briefly, holding up the MacBook box and then the iPhone box, smiling at the camera. The setting is a clean, well-lit electronics store. (5) The man is at a white retail counter interacting with two staff members, a male and a female, both wearing bright blue long-sleeved 'Straight A' shirts. He pulls out a student ID card and shows it to them, then later reveals a teacher's ID. The staff members look at the IDs with expressions of skepticism and then realization. The counter is clean, with various product boxes and a laptop visible. (6) A final shot shows the man at the same counter, leaning in to talk to the male staff member. The background is blurred, focusing on the interaction. A text overlay appears on a blurred background at the very end.
